en: Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a European town with 3–4‑storey houses and a prominent large Gothic brick church with a tall, slender spire dominating the skyline. A grass meadow occupies the foreground where a uniformed man and a child stand by the water. On the left, a small boat or ferry with people aboard is near the riverbank. A stone embankment lines the opposite shore with streets and more buildings stretching into the distance. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
